adjudication_note: Independent targeted-remediation holdout v3, frozen before C1E3 forensic review or C1F remediation design. DIRECT requires one principal causally attributable traded issuer with exact identity adjudicated independently of deterministic resolver coverage; PROXY requires exactly one bounded principal exposure and no eligible direct issuer; otherwise UNRESOLVED. Relevance and materiality do not determine mapping class.

input.title: Humana terminates a pharmacy administrator contract for one state plan
input.summary: Humana issued the termination notice for its own state-plan contract and named a replacement administrator effective next quarter.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Humana is the sole traded issuer making the contract decision for its own health-plan operations.

input.title: Coinbase restores withdrawals after replacing a failed signing cluster
input.summary: Coinbase reported that its own key-signing infrastructure caused the interruption and that withdrawals resumed after the cluster was replaced.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Coinbase owns the failed service infrastructure and is the only causal traded issuer in the report.

input.title: Chevron awards the removal contract for its retired North Sea platform
input.summary: Chevron selected the dismantling contractor and approved the schedule for a platform operated and owned by the company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Chevron is the sole operator and owner taking the company-specific decommissioning action.

input.title: Reddit revokes a data broker's API access after an audit
input.summary: Reddit completed the platform audit and disabled the broker's credentials under its own developer-access rules.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Reddit is the sole platform operator and directly takes the access-enforcement action.

input.title: Tesla changes the wording of service-appointment text reminders
input.summary: Tesla replaced one sentence in automated reminders sent by its service centres; appointment times and terms are unchanged.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The effect is minor, but Tesla is clearly responsible for a change to its own customer-service process.

input.title: IBM relocates a small patent archive within its Zurich campus
input.summary: IBM moved the archive between two company buildings and said public research access will be unavailable for one afternoon.

adjudicated_label.rationale: IBM alone controls the archive and the small operational relocation at its own campus.

input.title: Procter & Gamble revises carton recycling instructions for one soap line
input.summary: Procter & Gamble will print updated disposal guidance on future cartons without changing the product or package materials.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Procter & Gamble is directly responsible for the narrowly scoped packaging instruction change.

input.title: Netflix renews a six-desk dubbing office lease in Prague
input.summary: Netflix exercised a one-year renewal option for a small office used by its regional dubbing coordinators.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Netflix is the identified tenant taking a genuine but low-materiality property action.

input.title: Visa waives one manual-review fee for merchants in Fiji
input.summary: Visa removed a rarely charged network fee for a limited merchant group beginning next month.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Payment-network context identifies Visa Inc. as the issuer directly changing its own fee schedule.

input.title: Exxon ends public tours at a former research laboratory
input.summary: Exxon said the company-owned site will remain in use, but monthly visitor tours will cease after September.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Exxon is unambiguously the issuer making the limited decision for its own facility.

input.title: Amazon adds reusable delivery bags to one grocery route
input.summary: Amazon began the bag-return programme for orders packed and delivered through its own grocery service in Leeds.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Retail and delivery context makes Amazon the supported alias of Amazon.com, Inc., which operates the programme.

input.title: Google removes dormant classroom backups after a longer retention period
input.summary: Google updated retention rules for backups stored by schools in its Workspace service and notified administrators of the change.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Google clearly denotes Alphabet's operating business, while the resolver cannot choose one Alphabet listed share class.

input.title: Ford opens its design archive catalogue to university researchers
input.summary: Ford published a searchable catalogue for records held by the company's design archive and set researcher access terms.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Automotive and company-archive context identifies Ford Motor Company as the sole actor.

input.title: Corning licenses a fibre-coating patent to a private cable maker
input.summary: Corning granted a five-year non-exclusive licence covering a patent owned by the company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Corning is the sole traded licensor and the patent belongs to its own portfolio.

input.title: Yum! Brands selects a new reporting portal for franchisees
input.summary: Yum! Brands signed the vendor agreement and will require its restaurant franchisees to submit monthly operating reports through the portal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Yum! Brands is explicitly the contracting issuer and sets the reporting rule for its franchise system.

input.title: Rivian repays a municipal equipment loan ahead of schedule
input.summary: Rivian transferred the final balance on financing used for machinery at its service-parts operation.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Rivian is the named borrower taking the company-specific financing action.

input.title: Wise plc lowers the instant-transfer cap for one currency corridor
input.summary: Wise plc notified customers that it will apply the new cap to transfers processed on its own platform.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Wise plc is exactly identified as the causal traded issuer, but it is absent from the bounded resolver.

input.title: Marvell Technology cancels a networking-chip tapeout after verification errors
input.summary: Marvell Technology, Inc. said its engineering review found the errors and that the company cancelled the scheduled tapeout.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The legal issuer and its causal product decision are explicit, although the resolver has no Marvell entry.

input.title: Saab AB wins a radar-maintenance extension from Sweden
input.summary: The procurement authority awarded Saab AB the extension for radar systems maintained by the company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Saab AB is the exact traded contractor receiving the award, but the frozen resolver does not support it.

input.title: Apple recalls a charging cable after tests by supplier Belkin
input.summary: Apple issued the recall for cables sold in Apple-branded accessory packs; Belkin supplied test data but has no recall obligation.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Apple alone owns the branded packs and imposes the recall; Belkin is an evidentiary supplier.

input.title: NVIDIA writes off prepaid foundry capacity; TSMC keeps the deposit
input.summary: NVIDIA recorded the write-off after deciding not to use reserved capacity, while TSMC is named only as the contract counterparty.

adjudicated_label.rationale: NVIDIA's capacity decision and accounting charge are the event; TSMC is only the unaffected counterparty.

input.title: eBay settles a New York tax audit while Etsy discusses industry compliance
input.summary: The signed settlement binds eBay alone; an Etsy executive provides general commentary in a separate paragraph.

adjudicated_label.rationale: eBay is the only issuer legally bound by the settlement; Etsy is merely a commentator.

input.title: Fire destroys Nike-owned inventory at a contract warehouse
input.summary: Nike confirmed the destroyed footwear belongs to the company; the warehouse operator and a FedEx route are mentioned only in the site description.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Nike is the sole traded owner suffering the direct inventory loss; other names locate or service the site.

input.title: Meta discontinues Workplace while citing an older Slack migration study
input.summary: Meta set the shutdown date for its Workplace service; Slack appears only in historical migration research attached to the notice.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Meta alone closes its service; Slack is a contextual historical comparison rather than a causal issuer.

input.title: Novo Nordisk changes a medicine label after a regulator instruction
input.summary: Novo Nordisk will implement the label revision for its product; Pfizer is named only in a quotation about an unrelated earlier label case.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Novo Nordisk is the only issuer whose product and obligations are changed; Pfizer is contextual history.

input.title: Sovereign-compute budget uses NVIDIA server prices as an illustration
input.summary: The budget converts public capacity targets using catalogue prices for NVIDIA hardware, but opens no tender and creates no vendor eligibility or order.

adjudicated_label.rationale: NVIDIA is a pricing illustration only; no procurement, company action, or issuer-specific effect is established.

input.title: Pension report expresses a funding gap in units of Apple's market value
input.summary: The comparison makes the national shortfall easier to visualize but contains no finding, transaction, obligation, or forecast concerning Apple.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Apple is a high-salience unit of comparison, not the causal subject or an affected issuer.

input.title: Climate commission uses Exxon refinery data to illustrate a 1990 baseline
input.summary: The commission reproduces archived figures as a historical example and announces no current rule, finding, or effect concerning Exxon.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The material Exxon reference is historical evidence only and creates no present causal issuer event.

input.title: Oracle and SAP share customer refunds after a joint tax connector miscalculates VAT
input.summary: The incident agreement attributes half of the defective connector to each company and divides every refund and repair cost equally.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Oracle and SAP are explicitly equal causes of the defect and equal bearers of remediation, leaving no unique principal.

input.title: Ford and Tesla surrender equal emissions credits under a coordinated order
input.summary: The regulator cancels the same number of credits from each manufacturer for separate reporting breaches assessed as equally serious.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Ford and Tesla receive equal operative sanctions for equally weighted breaches, so neither issuer is principal.

input.title: Independent Visa and Mastercard configuration errors interrupt a shared gateway
input.summary: The operator's forensic report assigns half of the outage duration to each network's incompatible change and identifies no initiating network.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Both networks are independently and equally causal for the shared outage, so one DIRECT selection would be arbitrary.

input.title: Atlas reports a covenant breach after a warehouse valuation
input.summary: The bulletin omits the country, exchange, legal suffix, business line, and address even though several issuers use Atlas in their names.

adjudicated_label.rationale: A causal company is asserted, but the information cannot distinguish among multiple Atlas legal entities.

input.title: CAT service bulletin warns of hydraulic-hose fatigue
input.summary: The document does not identify an author, equipment manufacturer, exchange, legal name, or whether CAT is merely an internal category code.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The ticker-like token does not establish Caterpillar or any other exact traded issuer identity.

input.title: Orange Mobile outage spreads across the northern region
input.summary: The alert gives no country, network licence, parent company, legal entity, or exchange for the Orange-branded service.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The brand-level outage is causal, but its owning legal issuer cannot be identified from the supplied jurisdiction-free evidence.

input.title: SPY surveillance drone completes a coastal mapping trial
input.summary: SPY is the private laboratory's drone codename; the trial has no connection to the S&P 500, an ETF, or a listed manufacturer.

adjudicated_label.rationale: SPY is a project name rather than a legal issuer, security identity, or supported market exposure.

input.title: Applied Materials hosts an industry workshop on technician shortages
input.summary: The workshop surveys semiconductor employers generally and announces no Applied Materials decision, contract, award, or operational impact.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The company is only a host and the sector discussion does not establish a principal issuer or proxy event.

input.title: Amazon basin rainfall blocks a cocoa-growing road
input.summary: Amazon refers to the geographic basin; the report concerns local crop transport and identifies no Amazon.com operation or supported market proxy.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Amazon is a place name here, not the traded issuer, and cocoa transport is outside the bounded proxy set.

input.title: Delta Air Lines named as a possible beneficiary of cheaper jet fuel
input.summary: A strategist lists Delta with many airlines that might benefit if prices persist, but reports no purchase, hedge, guidance change, or company action.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Delta is only a speculative indirect beneficiary and no single bounded market exposure is the event's principal subject.

input.title: University loses a cloud grant and may reduce future Microsoft purchases
input.summary: The university is the grant recipient; Microsoft is one of several vendors whose later sales could decline, with no order cancelled or contract changed.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Microsoft is a possible downstream supplier exposure, not the causal principal or a confirmed affected issuer.

input.title: Private battery recycler receives a subsidy and cites Tesla as a potential customer
input.summary: The award goes only to the private recycler; Tesla has made no commitment and is included in a list of possible future buyers.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Tesla is neither award recipient nor committed customer, and the private-company event has no eligible proxy.

input.title: New insurance exclusion sharply reduces cover for crude cargoes
input.summary: Marine insurers adopted a market-wide exclusion for crude shipments without identifying any producer, tanker owner, or refiner as principal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: No eligible company is principal, while crude oil is the single bounded market exposure directly affected.

input.title: Federal Reserve lowers reserve requirements for a narrow bank category
input.summary: The official rule changes monetary conditions for the covered institutions and names no traded bank as a principal subject.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The official central-bank action has one supported duration exposure and no causal traded issuer.

input.title: Long-dated Treasury auction clears at an unexpectedly high yield
input.summary: The auction result is a US duration event and the report identifies no dealer or corporate issuer as the causal principal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: US rates are the single principal supported exposure, with no company issuer causally attributable.

input.title: Bullion exchange doubles margin on gold futures
input.summary: The exchange applies the margin increase to the gold market as a whole and does not identify a miner, dealer, or fund issuer as principal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Gold is the sole named principal market and there is no eligible direct issuer.

input.title: Clearinghouse triples collateral for all semiconductor stocks
input.summary: The clearing rule applies the same collateral schedule to the chip-stock group and does not single out any manufacturer or security.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The semiconductor group is the single bounded principal exposure and no individual issuer is selected.

input.title: S&P 500 index committee raises the minimum free-float threshold
input.summary: The methodology change applies to the named broad index and does not make any current constituent the principal subject.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The S&P 500 is the one explicit principal exposure and no constituent issuer is causally singled out.

input.title: Clearing venue admits gold and long-duration Treasury funds as equal collateral
input.summary: The emergency rule assigns identical haircuts and limits to both asset groups and names neither as the primary collateral market.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Gold and US duration are co-equal supported exposures under one rule, so no unique principal proxy may be chosen.

input.title: Golden Oil bakery wins the town's window-display prize
input.summary: Golden Oil is the bakery's registered trading name; the award has no connection to bullion, petroleum, a listed issuer, or financial markets.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Keyword overlap does not establish a gold or oil exposure, and no traded legal issuer is identified.
